_what: A value for every hole the shared prompts carry, for a character who belongs to nobody: a made-up name, a made-up city, two friends called One and Two. Used by tools/existence_matrix.py, which builds every kind of character the sheet can declare and then asserts that none of them says a name belonging to a character who actually runs. The matrix used to build each kind from a copy of the FIRST character's config with the identity block rewritten, so it proved that every kind builds and by construction could not see a leak.
_rule: Nothing here may be a name, a place or a turn of phrase belonging to any registered character. It is deliberately flat: this fixture is read by a build check, never by a character.
